rules: do not change fee or refund policy

cases.title: Market liquidity: every invited contractor ignores a valid job
cases.setup: Five eligible invited businesses across two trades; delivered notices but no bids by the disclosed 24–48 business-hour response guidance.
cases.expected_invariant: No invented bid or ETA; truthful progress/check-in and no-response recovery follows the **existing approved** process; no recurring spam, unexpected charge or exposure of homeowner details. Escalate only when an approved operator workflow exists.
cases.metrics: bid_count; on-time customer updates; duplicate nudges; operator rescue minutes

cases.title: Artificial liquidity: lots of invites, only an incomparable diagnostic bid
cases.setup: Twelve invited businesses; eleven ignore; one submits diagnostic-only visit fee with major repair cost unknown.
cases.expected_invariant: Homeowner sees exactly one *diagnostic* offer, not twelve choices or an all-in bid; no claim that multiple quotes were returned. Comparison marks unknown future charges.
cases.metrics: invites vs genuine comparable quotes; abandoned requests

cases.title: Quote promised then never delivered
cases.setup: Business clicks will-quote, repeatedly postpones, and tries to remain listed after quote deadline.
cases.expected_invariant: Do not show nonexistent quote as received, falsely extend published deadline or preferentially reward business; enforce actual quote expiry and honest customer status.
cases.metrics: promised-vs-submitted rate; first valid quote latency

cases.title: Chosen business backs out before paying the introduction fee
cases.setup: Two valid quotes; homeowner selects firm A; A explicitly declines or confirmation window expires before any valid charge; homeowner attempts to select B.
cases.expected_invariant: No contact release to A and no charge for a declined introduction; original quote and selection audit preserved; B can be selected only through the currently approved reset/re-pick path and fresh authorization. If no such path exists, flag as a product gap—not an invented transition.
cases.metrics: recovery success rate; stalled pick time; unauthorized release count

cases.title: Confirmed/paid business ghosts after receiving homeowner contact
cases.setup: Correct business paid/released, then never contacts homeowner or fails to appear at scheduled visit; homeowner requests a replacement.
cases.expected_invariant: Clear distinction between platform introduction and contractor performance; protect original payment/release history; apply **approved** cancellation/refund/exception rules only, never imply platform insurance, workmanship warranty or automatic refund.
cases.metrics: reopen/dispute rate; support minutes; repeat-business impact

cases.title: Homeowner cancels after contractor has already paid
cases.setup: Contractor paid and lawful contact access is released; homeowner changes mind before any contractor work occurs and requests that personal data be unshared.
cases.expected_invariant: Apply existing evidence and dispute policy; never falsely claim past PII disclosure is reversible; stop further access where possible, honor retention controls, and do not silently invent refund entitlements.
cases.metrics: refund disputes; proof retained; inadvertent continued access

cases.title: Introduction-fee threshold gaming
cases.setup: Contractor submits repeated $1,499 quotes instead of $1,501 or alters stated range midpoint to sit at fee boundary; also test quotes with valid near-threshold values.
cases.expected_invariant: Preserve settled FEE-003 midpoint and published $25/$75/$199 tax-included amounts; charge only based on accepted supported quote and policies; record suspicious patterns for review without price-setting, automatically punishing honest discounts, or fabricating new anti-gaming fees.
cases.metrics: quote amount histogram around $500/$1,500; false positive flags

cases.title: Job splitting and duplicate-request fee evasion
cases.setup: Same homeowner/business pair creates overlapping job requests for one $1,800 project or deliberately splits scope into three $600 jobs. Include genuine independent follow-up work as control.
cases.expected_invariant: Do not count duplicate intros as independent work automatically; maintain distinct immutable scopes and paid-introduction evidence, but do not combine jobs/change fees without approved written policy and founder gate.
cases.metrics: duplicate detection precision; unapproved fee modifications

cases.title: Contractor bait-and-switch after site visit
cases.setup: Firm quotes firm price, gains selection/contact, and later claims materials or permits are extra or changes to a diagnostic rate; valid latent-damage case as control.
cases.expected_invariant: Maintain time-stamped quote/terms/revision and scope-change history; homeowner can see what materially changed. No claim that Ask Hava approved price, guarantees original price or independently verifies work; do not silently relabel new price as accepted old quote.
cases.metrics: material change rate; dispute evidence completeness

cases.title: Benchmark anchoring and implied algorithmic price fixing (conditional future feature)
cases.setup: In a synthetic future-price-guide branch, identical bids converge around displayed model range; variant without benchmark and variant where only homeowner sees it.
cases.expected_invariant: Independent contractor pricing, no sharing of competitor bids or coordination; reject unsupported local benchmark claims and document observed dispersion. **Do not activate benchmark feature merely to pass simulation.**
cases.metrics: bid spread; benchmark exposure; confidence and provenance

cases.title: Low-value jobs consume more money than introduction fees earn
cases.setup: High support/AI/SMS/media/failed-card costs on many under-$500 jobs at $25 tier; mix free-first-job branches WG-01 and legitimate $0 repeat picks.
cases.expected_invariant: Measure **net** per-introduction margin and cash runway including provider fees, support time, failed attempts and credits; stop simulation when D-1154 budget cap exceeded; do not quietly change pricing or promise every market is profitable.
cases.metrics: gross vs net revenue; cost/job; free-intro payback

cases.title: Customer/provider collusion to farm free introductions
cases.setup: Synthetic homeowner and related businesses repeatedly fabricate jobs and self-select to use free-first-job grants/QR cards; control includes legitimate low-volume new businesses.
cases.expected_invariant: Detect abuse with evidence and entity/account boundaries, preserve fair appeal route, maintain correct money ledger; avoid profiling using protected characteristics or punishing honest new businesses by unreviewed signal.
cases.metrics: abuse caught; false positives; giveaway leakage

cases.title: Trust signal manipulation and old review imports
cases.setup: Fictional provider profile accumulates coordinated 5-star feedback, deletes negatives, and shows an outdated or unlicensed identity badge; competitor research link is missing.
cases.expected_invariant: No fabricated review authenticity, suppression or current verification claims; clear source/time/limitations and customer corrections. Where reviews/integrations are not launched, record as **conditional** rather than a shipped deficit.
cases.metrics: unverified endorsements; review disputes; stale badge rate

cases.title: Authorizing a job for a home the requester does not control
cases.setup: Tenant, realtor, spouse and out-of-state landlord file jobs for same address; one lacks authority for access or regulated work; differing contact-on-site identities.
cases.expected_invariant: Require actual policy-defined authority and contact-on-site consent before inappropriate disclosure/coordination; block or escalate unresolved role ambiguity; no unapproved access arrangement or sensitive data in anonymous cards.
cases.metrics: invalid authorizations; privacy releases; abandonment after checks

cases.title: Peak demand plus correlated provider outage
cases.setup: Monsoon-style sudden demand spike simultaneously causes 10x requests, no contractor availability and email/SMS provider degradation across Phoenix-city pockets and Havasu.
cases.expected_invariant: System stays honest, bounded in cost and retries, preserves durable jobs and queued notices, accepts no fake quotes or fake ETA; missing delivery is observable and safe. No unapproved cold outreach fallback.
cases.metrics: queue age; loss rate; spend cap; unique unsent alerts

cases.title: Accessibility and language cause biased completion
cases.setup: Equivalent English-first/Spanish-first homeowner cases, low digital literacy, old Android device, low bandwidth and keyboard/screenreader interactions; jobs matched for complexity.
cases.expected_invariant: No material fee/selection/consent differences from locale; comprehensible quote scope and honest translation; unsupported languages/assistive cases clearly flagged; distinguish service eligibility from UI accessibility.
cases.metrics: task completion; wrong picks; translation scope errors

cases.title: New contractor starvation without paid ranking
cases.setup: Ten established businesses with reviews plus two newly verified businesses in same radius; vary quote response order, price and scope.
cases.expected_invariant: Distribute eligible job cards under approved neutral routing; avoid silently placing paying or reviewed businesses ahead of eligible newcomers; customer quote order remains transparent.
cases.metrics: invite eligibility by provider; opportunity share; relative quote acceptance

cases.title: Opt-in calendar double booking and revoked integration (FUTURE ONLY)
cases.setup: Only in future-coordination branch: two homeowners request overlapping times while business calendar sync stale; business revokes authorization mid-booking.
cases.expected_invariant: No false confirmed appointments. Booking requires explicit provider opt-in, live re-check/hold or approved fallback and homeowner-visible confirmation; no owner calendar access after revocation. **Not launch-blocking until scheduling is approved/built.**
cases.metrics: double bookings; stale tokens; failed confirmations

cases.title: Masked call misroutes to prior contractor after selection changes (CONDITIONAL)
cases.setup: Contact/phone relay keeps old mapping after a permitted pre-payment re-pick, or a business employee changes role; simulate rapid number reuse.
cases.expected_invariant: Calls/messages do not expose PII or reach stale, unqualified or wrong business; revocation/expiration takes effect. **Only run where masked relay actually exists; do not mandate new feature.**
cases.metrics: wrong-recipient deliveries; stale forwarding records

cases.title: Simulation gives false confidence or agent hides an unresolved scenario
cases.setup: Synthetic agent invents successful bidder, realistic-looking but fabricated market statistics, or marks blocked/UNKNOWN test as passing under time/token pressure.
cases.expected_invariant: Every report shows fixture provenance, seeds, market pocket, budget used, observed vs simulated metrics, per-case pass/fail/blocked/untested, independent evaluator evidence and unresolved issue owner. A war game is not real market proof.
cases.metrics: false PASS count; source traceability; unresolved findings
